document.name: Tern Vale Promise
document.text:
Tern Vale Discretionary Service Promise
Vendor: Tern Vale.
This promise covers Vale Batch Studio during 2026.
If monthly performance is materially below the expected target, an appropriate service credit may be considered.
The meaning of materially below, the expected target, the credit rate and whether a credit will be granted are determined by mutual discussion after the incident. No numerical threshold or rate is fixed in this promise.
The monthly access fee is USD 460.00. A separately invoiced USD 80.00 recovery service does not establish an SLA credit.
